name: ad-acl-dcsync-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): grants DCSync rights -- DS-Replication-Get-Changes and DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All extended rights on the domain root -- to a trustee account. Vars: TRUSTEE (required, SamAccountName of an existing account, pair with ad-user-win). An account holding these rights can dump every domain hash (DCSync) without ever logging on; nobody but the DCs themselves should hold them. Idempotent: identical ACEs are merged by AddAccessRule. Must run AFTER the domain and the trustee exist. Pairs with powershell_json checks over (Get-Acl "AD:\<rootDn>").Access filtered on the trustee SID and the two replication-right GUIDs.
script:
if (-not $TRUSTEE) { throw 'TRUSTEE is required' }
Import-Module ActiveDirectory -ErrorAction Ignore
$trustee = Get-ADUser -Filter "SamAccountName -eq '$TRUSTEE'" -ErrorAction Ignore
if (-not $trustee) { throw "TRUSTEE '$TRUSTEE' does not exist (pair with ad-user-win)" }
$rootDn = (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName
$acl = Get-Acl "AD:\$rootDn"
$rights = [System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryRights]::ExtendedRight
$allow = [System.Security.AccessControl.AccessControlType]::Allow
$guids = @(
    [Guid]'1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2',
    [Guid]'1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2'
)
foreach ($g in $guids) {
    $rule = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.ActiveDirectoryAccessRule($trustee.Sid, $rights, $allow, $g)
    $acl.AddAccessRule($rule)
}
Set-Acl -Path "AD:\$rootDn" -AclObject $acl
